name: Tony Tony Chopper
description: End-of-Wano adaptation: selected Points, controlled Monster Point and healing support. Numbers, upgrades and duration are gameplay tuning; healing is not a damage buff. Guard, Walk, animal translation, Chopperphage curing and infant aftermath are omitted.

paths.name: Physician's Kit
paths.description: Medical support and diagnosis path. Purchases replace its support pulse or improve detection; healing never cures statuses or grants ally damage buffs.

upgrades.name: Field Triage
upgrades.description: Adds a faster, two-patient field-care pulse for sustained ally recovery.

upgrades.name: Rapid Diagnosis
upgrades.description: Improves encounter detection, conditionally helping against concealed enemies.

upgrades.name: Multi-Patient Care
upgrades.description: Expands Chopper's treatment routine to three injured allies at once.

upgrades.name: Emergency Medicine
upgrades.description: Shortens the treatment interval and reaches allies across a wider treatment area.

upgrades.name: Universal Doctor
upgrades.description: Maximizes routine field healing for crowded encounters with several injured allies.

paths.name: Rumble Ball Research
paths.description: Point-specialization path for stronger, faster personal combat. Damage, timing and reach values are explicit gameplay adaptations, not canon measurements.

upgrades.name: Heavy Point Formula
upgrades.description: Adds force to every primary impact across Chopper's selected Points.

upgrades.name: Arm Point Formula
upgrades.description: Multiplies the practical damage of Chopper's physical primary attacks.

upgrades.name: Kung Fu Formula
upgrades.description: Refines transitions and footwork so primary cycles complete more quickly.

upgrades.name: Point Specialization
upgrades.description: Extends the effective reach of Chopper's close-quarters forms.

upgrades.name: Monster Point Formula
upgrades.description: Further multiplies personal primary damage after the full Point research path is developed.

paths.name: Battlefield Analysis
paths.description: Tactical combat path based on Chopper's observation, deduction and physical restraint. Armor interaction and impact control are gameplay adaptations.

upgrades.name: Tactical Deduction
upgrades.description: Allows a lost primary target to be replaced at resolution without restarting its windup.

upgrades.name: Restraint Anatomy
upgrades.description: Adds a conditional contact stun against eligible weak-willed, stunnable targets.

upgrades.name: Horn Leverage
upgrades.description: Uses antler angles and anatomical targeting to partially ignore armor.

upgrades.name: Combat Footwork
upgrades.description: Improves primary timing when switching between close-range Point techniques.

upgrades.name: Critical Anatomy
upgrades.description: Adds another flat damage increment to carefully selected primary impacts.
